testcase.system-out: Scenario: Dock a panel to each supported workspace edge ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And a dockable panel is floating over the workspace ✔ When the user docks the panel to the right workspace edge ✔ Then the panel is attached along the right edge ✔ And the viewport occupies the workspace to its left ✔ When the user docks the panel to the top workspace edge ✔ Then the panel is attached below the ribbon ✔ And the viewport occupies the workspace below the panel ✔ When the user docks the panel to the bottom workspace edge ✔ Then the panel is attached above the document tabs and status area ✔ And the viewport occupies the workspace above the panel
